name: Earth's Groudon ex Constructed Starter Deck

releases.name: Earth's Groudon ex Constructed Starter Deck

description.text: A starter deck built around Groudon ex, sold at Pokémon Centers from 3 March 2006 and in shops from 10 March, the same days as the Miracle Crystal expansion. Swampert's evolution line and δ Delta Species Charmander and Charmeleon back it up. It is a ready-built 30-card half deck with a coin, damage counters and markers, and a rule book.
